name: shellfs
description: Use Unix pipes as DuckDB filenames. Append `|` to a path and DuckDB executes it as a shell pipeline and reads from stdout; prefix with `|` to write to stdin. Lets read_csv / read_json / COPY chain into curl, awk, custom scripts — anything that speaks stdio.

cta.title: Pipe Anything Into DuckDB
cta.description: Install the `Shellfs` extension to treat shell pipelines as readable / writable filenames — read_csv 'seq 1 100 | grep 2 |' just works.

quickStart.title: Curl directly into a JSON read
Pipe out of DuckDB into another program
quickStart.sql: COPY (SELECT * FROM range(1000) t(n)) TO '| gzip > out.csv.gz';
